data.name: Trading.Disclaimer.NotAdvice
data.value: ZettaTrade is educational software, not investment advice. Nothing in this application, its documentation or the AI chat is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any asset or instrument.

data.value: This is alpha software: behavior, settings keys and file formats can change between alpha builds without notice; the exact build shows in the status bar.

data.name: Trading.Disclaimer.PaperFirst
data.value: The shipped trading backend is a paper-trading simulator — simulated fills against live market prices; it never touches real funds or exchange keys. The adapters read their endpoints from the settings file, so testnet-first is a config change, not a code change.

data.name: Trading.Disclaimer.RealFunds
data.value: Do not use the app with real funds before you have tested it yourself. Start on testnets and paper trading, verify the app's behavior on your own, and never risk money you cannot afford to lose. Trading involves substantial risk of loss; you are responsible for your own decisions, your own testing and your own funds.

data.name: Trading.Disclaimer.KeyHygiene
data.value: API keys are the user's responsibility: create user-scoped keys — read-only for market data, trade-only for trading (withdrawal and transfer permissions off), an IP allowlist wherever the venue offers one — and store them only in the app's per-machine secret store.

data.name: Trading.Disclaimer.WhereToRead
data.value: Full guidance: README.md (trading safety) and docs/SECURITY.md (secrets).
